Math

Inline dollars a+b and parens c^2 are kept as TeX.

The energy is

E = mc^2 (1)

as in (1).

Display brackets:

\sum_{i=1}^n i = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}

And double dollars:

\int_0^1 x\,dx = \tfrac12

\begin{aligned}
f(x) &= x^2
\end{aligned} (2)

\begin{aligned}
g(x) &= 2x
\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}
h(x) &= x^3
\end{aligned} (3)

Unnumbered:

a=b

Tagged:

\tag{$\star$} c=d ($\star$)

Equation 3 and (2).
